description: It's our hard-earned money. Reducing government spending and increasing your pay will stimulate economic growth in our district. Minnesota's tax burden is too high -- we're the 4th highest taxed state in the nation, and our lowest tax rate is higher than most states' highest tax rate. Reducing and simplifying taxes will keep more money in your pocket and make Minnesota more competitive. Jeff will support efforts to reduce the size of government so we can lower our tax rates. Jeff will fight to lower property taxes, and rather than picking winners and losers with corporate subsidies, focus on making Minnesota more friendly for business so businesses of all sizes and relocate and thrive here.
